target.title: fix(infra): drop replacement characters when response snippets truncate UTF-8
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users could see replacement characters in bounded web/provider error snippets when a response body was truncated in the middle of a multi-byte UTF-8 character.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bounded response readers now use streaming decode only for truncated byte prefixes, so incomplete trailing UTF-8 sequences are omitted instead of rendered as replacement characters. The change keeps the normal full-response decode path flushing normally, uses fresh UTF-8 fallback decoders so fallback cannot retain streaming state between responses, and applies the same byte-prefix invariant across web, provider, generic HTTP, and memory-host SDK snippet readers.

## User Impact

Provider error details, generic HTTP snippets, web_fetch snippets, and memory-host remote HTTP snippets remain clean and readable when OpenClaw caps large response bodies at a byte boundary.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: bounded response text helpers drop partial UTF-8 characters when stream reads stop at maxBytes, while preserving clean full-response and fallback charset decoding.
- Current-head proof at 2c929c4ed3a4bad64f6b4fa956b39c2b9b100fbb: `node --import tsx -e "import { readResponseTextSnippet } from './packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/response-snippet.ts'; const stream = new ReadableStream({ start(controller) { controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode('ab' + String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600) + 'cd')); } }); console.log(await readResponseTextSnippet(new Response(stream), { maxBytes: 3, maxChars: 100 }));"` printed `ab... [truncated]`.
- Current-head focused tests at 2c929c4ed3a4bad64f6b4fa956b39c2b9b100fbb: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/response-snippet.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-shared.test.ts src/infra/http-error-body.test.ts src/agents/provider-http-errors.test.ts src/infra/http-body.response.test.ts` passed 3 Vitest shards / 69 tests.
- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Duplicate search: no open or closed OpenClaw PRs found for the bounded response UTF-8 truncation / replacement-character issue.
